observations: Actual JWT login creates the deterministic company/account Matrix user and HRIS device.
Five-second nonrefreshable tokens expire while replacement credentials retain the same uploaded signed public device keys.
Logout with the expired old bearer deletes the entire device, replacement credentials and public device keys. It is unsafe compensation for a losing login.
Malformed, duplicate, trailing, oversized, wrongly encoded responses and unbounded provider token lifetimes are rejected.
Redirects are not followed; body reception has a deadline and cancellation; no automatic provider retry.
initialFailures: Missing explicit Jackson dependency failed compilation; added existing catalog alias.
Werror rejected redundant casts; removed casts.
Formatter rejected the cast-removal layout; formatted and reran successfully.
designCorrection: Losing internal candidates remain unpublished behind the private provider network and expire within ten minutes. Device logout requires irreversible HRIS revocation. Provider HTTP success still requires a use-case admission/fence before publication.
limits: Transport is not yet wired to provisioning or a public gateway.
Schema 106 still needs a migration to persist token expiry; live runtime remains schema 103.
Bounded provider lifetime must also be configured and verified on deployed Synapse.
No physical phone action or reusable Starter port.

hostedFailure.reason: The fixture interrupted its HTTP executor immediately after releasing handler latches; a waking handler could report cleanup-induced InterruptedException as a server assertion.
hostedFailure.correction: After release, shut the fixture executor down gracefully, await at most five seconds, and reserve interruption for failed termination. No timeout/cancellation assertion was removed.
